title: Boston Gas Company files for review and approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a 365 Day Transportation Agreement with Brookhouse Condominium Trust.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the proposed Agreement. The Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 00-27)
